claims.subject: income_threshold
claims.statement: The committee decided to raise the household income threshold from $90,000 to $120,000.
claims.quote: The committee decided to raise the household income threshold from $90,000 to $120,000 because of cost-of-living pressures in the Riverbend region.

claims.subject: other
claims.statement: The average time to payment was reported as 26 days.
claims.quote: The Chief Finance Officer reported that the average time to payment was 26 days.

claims.subject: other
claims.statement: The committee asked Finance to aim for payment within 21 days by the end of July.
claims.quote: The committee asked Finance to aim for 21 days by the end of July.
